# Aman Jain

AI and analytics professional based in Bengaluru, India. Currently an AI Analyst at Impact Analytics and a Computer Science graduate of NIT Raipur.

## Core work

- Enterprise retail analytics and demand-forecasting data readiness
- Data integration and validation across BigQuery, GCS and Snowflake
- Python and SQL automation, Airflow-scheduled reporting and forecast evaluation
- Applied AI systems using RAG, LangGraph, tool calling, memory and FastAPI
- Product configuration, implementation readiness and cross-functional client delivery

## Selected projects

- Agentic AI Workspace: stateful, source-grounded analytical assistant
- US Visa Prediction E2E: production-minded ML pipeline from ingestion to model promotion
- AI Calling Agent: real-time speech, reasoning and voice workflow
